identification: Oil on board/canvas 'after David Boyd': yellow ochre ground, dark green tree upper right, small blue and red figures (Boyd-style lovers/figures in flight) and scattered birds, loose gestural grass strokes. Distressed gilt frame. Catalogue says 'after', so an unsigned amateur copy/pastiche, not a Boyd. 40 x 50 cm. Estimate 30-50, current bid $15.

entries.note: Antique-style oil 'after Boucher', ornate gilt frame, 11 bids. Decorative copy, same class as this lot.
Tavern interior 'after Teniers', old master style, gilt frame, 1 bid. Older-looking copy, more saleable than a modern Boyd pastiche.
Large oil 'after Millet' Angelus, 24x36 in, 2 bids. Shows the floor for 'after' copies.
